# QDarkStyleSheet

Source: https://github.com/ColinDuquesnoy/QDarkStyleSheet

Version: **v.3.2.3**, commit `6f3962e63749893f951be73ebfec93e83fffebf2`.

Copyright (c) 2013-2019 Colin Duquesnoy. Images also copyright (c) 2019 Daniel Cosmo Pizetta.

The two upstream QSS files, QRC manifests and `rc/` directories are vendored unchanged.
Code is MIT licensed; images are CC BY 4.0 licensed. See the complete terms in
`LICENSE.rst` and https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

Lighter recolors the base QSS palette at runtime and appends its application styles
from `native/styles/lighter.qss`. No Python package or network access is needed
to build or run the application. This notice and the license are installed with Lighter.
